method: Physical lines in committed first-party application source and tests/test support, including comments and blank lines. Excludes dependencies, build output, generated native projects, assets, lockfiles and type declarations. Documentation, tooling and configuration are counted separately and are not included in these source figures.
coverageScope: Saved unit/component coverage reports for the configured executable JavaScript/TypeScript source. Coverage percentages do not apply to every physical line in the repository. CSS, schema/migrations, dependencies, generated output and other uninstrumented files are outside the measured coverage scope.

ttsnative.name: TTSNative
ttsnative.sourceScope: Web app (apps/web/src, index.html and runtime scripts in public/), local server (apps/server/src), voice-cloning worker (apps/chatterbox-worker/src) and website (site/*.html, *.css, *.js). Excludes the generated API types, build and release scripts, configuration and documentation.

coverage.source: GitHub Actions CI run on main (commit 7563eb3)
coverage.scope: Web app unit/component tests (Vitest) and server tests (pytest with branch coverage). The voice-cloning worker and the website are outside the coverage scope.
